# VNV Gourmet

VNV Gourmet is the event catering and hospitality service by VNV Events in South Florida. It focuses on fast luxury food solutions for events, from intimate gatherings to large galas, with polished stations, appetizers, desserts, staff and beverage support.

## Main Event Services

- Appetizers
- Brunch stations
- Crepes stations
- Pasta stations
- Pizza stations
- Paella and tapas stations
- Taco stations
- Sushi presentations
- Sweets and dessert stations
- Entrees and sides for events
- Servers, bartenders and hospitality support
